page_title: WHU 4-1 IPS | West Ham v Ipswich 05/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+2' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.
90+1' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul. West Ham have a free kick from a promising distance.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Half-chance! Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) plays a pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric reacts well to snuff out the attack.

88' Ambitious effort from Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
86' Substitution. Luis Guilherme (West Ham) in, Mohammed Kudus out.
85' The ball rebounds out to Carlos Soler (West Ham) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing.
83' Kieran McKenna has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) replacing Omari Hutchinson.
83' That's the end of the game for Liam Delap, who is replaced by George Hirst (Ipswich).
83' Julen Lopetegui has decided to substitute Lucas Paqueta and he is replaced by Crysencio Summerville (West Ham).
83' The referee signals a substitution. Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Emerson.

83' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play and West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Arijanet Muric was alert and made a comfortable save.

79' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Arijanet Muric is alert and denies him with a nice save.
78' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
74' Substitution. Wes Burns leaves the pitch and is replaced by Chiedozie Ogbene (Ipswich).
74' Here's the change. Kalvin Phillips leaves the pitch and Jack Taylor (Ipswich) comes on as a substitute.
73' Kieran McKenna has decided to make a change. Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich) replaces Jack Clarke.
70' Julen Lopetegui decides to make a substitution. Guido Rodriguez will be replaced by Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Carlos Soler (West Ham) for Michail Antonio.
69' 4 - 1 Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) produces a beautiful volley and the ball goes into the back of the net!
68' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
67' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

66' Liam Delap (Ipswich) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads towards the left side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him. It will be a corner kick for Ipswich.
65' Wes Burns (Ipswich) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
60' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Arijanet Muric.
59' Poor challenge! Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
55' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich).
54' Ipswich take a short corner kick.
53' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Tomas Soucek (West Ham), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
49' 3 - 1 Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Arijanet Muric with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
49' Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.

45+3' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) wins himself some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a low shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
45+3' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for West Ham.
45+2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but it ends somewhere in row Z.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Michail Antonio (West Ham) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
43' 2 - 1 Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
41' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Arijanet Muric easily deals with the threat.
40' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) fires the ball towards the left side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
37' Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) beats his marker in the air and aims a header at goal from the free kick, but the close-range effort flashes just past the left post.
36' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

35' The ball falls for Tomas Soucek (West Ham) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there! The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
33' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
31' A yellow card for a tackle by Jack Clarke (Ipswich). Anthony Taylor doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
31' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
31' Emerson (West Ham) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
30' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is able to continue to play.
29' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) commits a rough foul. Anthony Taylor stops the game and makes a call.
28' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
27' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jack Clarke (Ipswich) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Kalvin Phillips (Ipswich) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
24' Leif Davis (Ipswich) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
23' The linesman points to the corner flag, Ipswich are going to take it.
23' Wes Burns (Ipswich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
21' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
20' West Ham fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.

15' That didn't go as planned! Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Arijanet Muric, who easily kept it out.
12' Michail Antonio (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' West Ham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

9' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Arijanet Muric. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
6' 1 - 1 Liam Delap (Ipswich) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
6' The ball is out of play and Ipswich manage to earn a corner.
4' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

1' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Michail Antonio (West Ham) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box low into the middle of the target. The assist goes to Jarrod Bowen and the score changes to 1:0.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Ipswich will kick-off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
